snippet.title: NEKOTYPE KEYBOARD CAT SIMULATOR TRAILER 2
snippet.description:
#Nekotype #IndieGame #CatGame
Get ready to purr-fect your typing skills with Nekotype Keyboard Cat Simulator! Coming to Steam on December 12, 2025, this isn't just a game; it's your new, adorable typing buddy! Meet NEKO, your tiny, super-fast keyboard companion who will type along with you, bringing a whole new level of cuteness and energy to your workspace. Every keystroke, every word, shared with a furry friend! This simulation game is the perfect casual escape, offering a unique blend of fun and productivity. Add it to your wishlist now and get ready to unleash your inner cat-lover and create amazing content, one purrfectly typed line at a time! We can't wait to type with you!
